desc:
🌙 UPDATE v2.1: SLENDERMAN, WEREWOLF & SKINWALKER!
👁️ At night become Slenderman (fast when nobody looks), the Werewolf (fastest sprinter) or the Skinwalker (takes a deer's shape).
🏹 3 NEW HUNTER CLASSES: Spotter, Medic and Lantern Keeper.

🎃 HALLOWEEN EVENT: collect glowing pumpkins, earn Candy and unlock limited cosmetics!

One of these deer is not a deer. 🦌
A 2–4 player hidden-predator hunt. Play with friends or solo against AI.

🏹 HUNTERS: search the herd with bows and trail cams. Shooting innocent deer costs sanity.
🦌 PREDATORS: blend in, eat, whistle and play dead. Break their sanity and night falls...
🌙 NIGHT: predators become creatures. Hunters must survive, reach a cabin or bring them down.

🗺️ 6 maps · 🎯 6 classes · 👹 4 creatures · ✨ Skins · 📜 Quests & leaderboards

Hunter: Click shoot, E cam, T view cams, F light
Deer: E eat, Space boost, Q whistle, G play dead
Creature: Click claw, Space pounce, Q roar (Skinwalker: F deer)
